beats.summary: Pam discusses her positive feelings about Valentine's Day in the office.

evidence.snippet: Pam: I really like Valentine's Day in this office. It's kinda like grade school. Everybody gives out little presents and stuff.

beats.summary: Pam receives flowers and a card from the delivery man.

evidence.snippet: Pam (Delivery man enters with a bouquet of red roses. Pam stands up to look at card.): Phyllis.
Delivery Man: Would you sign here?

beats.summary: Pam mentions her and Roy are saving for their wedding and not expecting big gifts.

evidence.snippet: Pam: Roy and I are saving for the wedding, so I made him promise not to get me anything too big.

beats.summary: Meredith and Phyllis comment on a Valentine's Day card from Bob Vance.

evidence.snippet: Meredith: "Happy Valentine's Day darling. Love Bob Vance, Vance Refrigeration."
Phyllis: Isn't he sweet?

beats.summary: Michael discusses his trip to New York and his interactions with Jan on Valentine's Day.

evidence.snippet: Michael: This is a business trip. I would have to be a raving lunatic to try to talk to Jan about what happened between us.

beats.summary: Kelly shares her excitement about hooking up with Ryan, leading to a discussion about their relationship status.

evidence.snippet: Kelly: So I said, "Ryan, what took you so long?" And I just said that to him, can you believe that?

beats.summary: Jim talks about not having a Valentine and plans to play cards with friends.

evidence.snippet: Jim: So I broke up with Katy and haven't been dating anybody else, so this year I don't have to worry about Valentine's Day.

beats.summary: Jim receives a bobblehead gift, which excites Dwight.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Yeah, but who put it here? And for what purpose?
Jim: It was there when I sat down.
Dwight (opens box and reads card): Happy Valentine's Day. It's me. I'm the bobble head. Yes! Ahh!

beats.summary: Michael explores New York City, visiting landmarks and commenting on his surroundings.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Here it is, heart of New York City, Times Square.
Michael: This is the world famous Rockefeller Center.

beats.summary: Dwight and Angela discuss Valentine's Day gifts, with Angela indicating she did not receive one.

evidence.snippet: Angela: I didn't get anything for Valentine's Day.
Dwight: Oh I did. I did.
